planRows.shortDesc: Home is just off Highway 57. We’re a short drive from Santiago de Querétaro, and 20 minutes from Antea Lifestyle Center and Parque Industrial Querétaro. Authentic Mexican cuisine is 10 minutes away at Plaza Náutica Juriquilla, or cook for yourself in your in-suite kitchen. Relax at our complimentary evening social, Monday Thursday. Breakfast and WiFi are on us.
planRows.headline: Easy access to Querétaro and local cuisine
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located at the main entrance to Juriquilla right at the intersection with Highway 57 direction to Queretaro.
planRows.directionsTo:
From North (San Luis Potosi and Monterrey): Take Highway 57 toward Queretaro, take the exit to Juriquilla suburb and then go straight until you reach the U-turn heading back to Queretaro, the hotel is located in the intersection of Juriquilla's exit and Highway 57.

From Mexico City and from the Queretaro's Airport (QRO): Take Highway 57 following signs to Juriquilla or San Luis Potosi, go straight until you are able to take the Juriquilla exit to an above highway bridge. Take the U-turn back to Queretaro, the hotel is located on the intersection of Juriquilla's exit and Highway 57.

From el Bajio (Celaya, Guadalajara, Morelia, Leon, Guanajuato): Taking either highway either "Cuota" or "Libre" take the exit to San Luis Potosi that would put you on Highway 57. Go straight north until you can take the Juriquilla's exit, go straight until you reach the U-turn going back to Queretaro, the hotel is located on the intersection of Juriquilla's exit and Highway 57.

planRows.directoryName: Homewood Suites by Hilton Santo Domingo
planRows.shortDesc: Centered in Santo Domingo, we're near local restaurants and a block from shopping and entertainment at Blue Mall. The Colonial Zone, Los Tres Ojos National Park, and Guibia beach are within a 15-minute drive. Amenities include a free hot breakfast, fitness center, and a rooftop bar and pool. Enjoy our complimentary Wednesday evening social.
planRows.headline: Soak it all in at our rooftop pool
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located in Financial District, close to main corporate companies, entertainment (Restaurants, Bars, Movie Theater) and shopping area of the city.
planRows.directionsTo: Take Las Americas Highway towards Santo Domingo. Continue onto Expreso Las Americas and take the tunnel. Continue onto Expreso 27 de Febrero. Take Duarte highway all the way and turn right into Maximo Gomez Ave. Turn left onto highway John F Kennedy. Continue straight until Highway Churchill Ave at your left. The hotel will be ahead at your right.
